Operational_Need: Organization expands workforce and adds new physical work zones without redesigning the core network backbone.
Business_Context_Impact: Requires a scalable multi-tier structure (Access Switches mapped to distinct floors/zones connected to a central aggregation point).

Operational_Need: Different staff roles (Dev, QA, HR, Finance) and external visitors require distinct access permissions to sensitive databases and corporate resources.
Business_Context_Impact: Requires functional departments to be isolated into dedicated subnets/VLANs, with Guest/IoT devices restricted to Internet-only access.

Operational_Need: VoIP phones, Wireless APs, and Surveillance cameras must receive power directly over Ethernet cables and maintain connectivity during single link/node failures.
Business_Context_Impact: Requires Access Switches to support PoE/PoE+ and redundant uplinks to the aggregation/core level.

Operational_Need: Employees or visitors plugging rogue routers or unauthorized DHCP servers into office wall jacks must not disrupt network IP addressing or create network loops.
Business_Context_Impact: Requires edge access ports to enforce DHCP Snooping and Spanning-Tree guard mechanisms.
